'''K3-R1'''<ref name="LEGO">''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga]]''</ref> was an [[R5 series astromech droid]]<ref name="RSOWM" /> with [[Color|turquoise]] plating, grey sensors.<ref name="TROS" />

K3-R1 served as a [[droid]] copilot on board the [[Comeuppance|Y-wing]] [[pilot]]ed by [[Zorii Bliss]], a [[Kijimi]] [[spicerunner]], which flew with the [[Citizens' Fleet]] in aid of [[Resistance]] forces in their [[Battle of Exegol|battle]] with the [[Sith Eternal]] over [[Exegol]].<ref name="TROS" />

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:K3-R1.png|thumb|right|250px|K3-R1 as depicted in ''LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga'']]
K3-R1 first appeared in the film [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']], and was identified in the video game ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga]]''. K3-R1's designation resembles a stylization of the name "Keri". [[Zorii Bliss]], to whom the astromech droid served as copilot, was portayed by actress [[Keri Russell]] in [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']].<ref name="TROS" />
